lines.text: Make a party? No, have one!
Many learners say: We made a party on Saturday.
Better: We had a party on Saturday.
Had! We had a party on Saturday.

data.wrong: We made a party on Saturday.
data.right: We had a party on Saturday.

native.tip: En español “hacer una fiesta”, pero en inglés la fiesta se “tiene”: “have a party.”

en.tip: Learners say “hacer una fiesta”, but English says “have a party.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “We made a party on Saturday.” “Hacer una fiesta” does not use “make” in English: “We had a party on Saturday.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
